manifest.scope:
Saved degree-two potential identities and direct remainder decomposition.

No fitted state is recomputed; archived theta is restored. No RHS or evolution.
Local Taylor coefficients are frozen at each actual midpoint cell centroid.

full_step.note: Each cell has its own fixed Taylor coefficients. Only actual Phi, not P2 alone, admits global shared-face cancellation. Fixed mass endpoints vs stored nonzero dm recorded separately.

polynomial.limits: Longdouble remainder arithmetic reduces cancellation; density and its quadrature weights remain original binary64. No evolved Psi claim or epsilon sweep.

manifest.scope:
Fixed four-state saved midpoint density derivative, not time evolution.

Only x/W/q/Q follow the saved actual stage direction. Mass and frozen rows
remain exact, factors/velocities/Pi remain untouched. No RHS or weight solve.

directional.interpretation: Candidate closure derivative is unconfirmed if graph/prior branches change or two scales are unstable. No automatic epsilon sweep. P2 raw evaluation uses longdouble; remainder directly integrated with original binary64 density. Fit residual and P2 quadrature constraint defects are separately retained, not hidden by thermal correction.

derivative_caution: Branch changes preclude claiming a confirmed global smooth derivative from this experiment; no additional epsilon runs were authorized or performed.
